messages:
Marta: Found a mystery Tupperware in the office fridge. No name. If it's yours, claim it by 5pm or it's communal :eyes: pic: https://imgur.com/abcd1234
Kai: Looks like questionable quinoa. I'm voting :shrug:
Josh: I'm tempted. React :one: if you want me to open it, :two: if we wait till owner claims
Rebecca: There's a sticky note under the shelf that says 'Asha?' maybe it's hers
Asha: Haha that's mine sometimes but I haven't packed anything today. Could be from yesterday's meetup.
Marta: Quick poll — what's inside? 1) Salad 2) Leftover curry 3) Mystery protein. React with :one:/:two:/:three:
Josh: Voted :three: (brave)
Asha: I'll check after standup and claim if it's mine. If not, communal snack agreed.
LunchBot: Reminder set — if unclaimed at 5pm I'll ping #kitchen-waste for composting pickup :bell:
Rebecca: Also can we get a "label your tupperware" sticker sheet for the pantry? :memo:
Kai: +1 to stickers. Also :popcorn: for whoever opens it first.
Marta: Update: Asha confirms it's not hers. Josh, you can open it at 5 if still there. :thumbsup:
Josh: Opening soon. If it's curry I'm burning it. :dash:
Marta: Cool — decision made. Whoever opens, snap a pic before digging in? :)
Rebecca: Agreed. Also adding a small sticky-note station by the fridge.
LunchBot: Compost pickup scheduled for 17:15 if item remains unclaimed.
Marta: Thread closed once claim or composted. Thanks everyone!
